start: Any screen of the member app (for example Profile); button on by default; no unread reply

steps.action: Tap the round tab peeking from the right edge (read aloud 'Send feedback about this screen')
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Help and feedback'
'Ask about this screen and get an answer at once, or tell us what is wrong here.'
Box 'Type here, or tap Speak'
Send greyed out until something is typed
'To turn off this round button: Settings → "Help and feedback".'
must_not: The sheet opens for a different screen
The tab sits over the tab bar, the top bar or a screen's main button

steps.action: Type 'Where do I change kg to lb?' and tap Send
user_sees: 'Sending. The answer usually takes a few seconds.'
A 'Quick answer' card, or 'Thanks! We read every message.'
'Your questions and answers are kept in Profile → Settings → Help and feedback.'
must_not: Two messages sent
The screen name sent carries a record id or code instead of ':id'
The typed words cleared when the send failed

start: Live workout screen (the floating tab is hidden there) with a workout running

steps.action: Tap the feedback button in the workout's top bar
user_sees: The same 'Help and feedback' sheet, for the live workout screen
must_not: The floating tab shown over the set ticks, the rest timer or Finish
The workout paused or ended

steps.action: Type a message, tap Send, close the sheet
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.' or a Quick answer
The workout screen as it was
must_not: Rest timer reset
A set lost

start: Help and feedback sheet open on any screen

steps.action: Leave the box empty (or only spaces) and tap Send
user_sees: Send stays greyed out; nothing is sent
must_not: An empty message sent
'Thanks! We read every message.' shown

steps.action: Turn the internet off, type a message, tap Send
user_sees: Red line "Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again. Your message is still here."
The typed words still in the box
must_not: The words lost
A success line for a message that was not sent

steps.action: Open the Calendar, the live workout screen and the workout-complete screen
user_sees: No floating tab on those screens
must_not: The tab over the Calendar's Sunday column taking a day's tap

steps.action: Open the keyboard in any text box
user_sees: The floating tab hides while the keyboard is open
must_not: The tab sitting on the keyboard

start: Profile → Settings → Help and feedback; switch 'Show the feedback button on every screen' on

steps.action: Turn the switch off, go back to any tab
user_sees: No round tab on any screen
must_not: The tab still shows with no unread reply

steps.action: The MettleUp team replies to an earlier question; bring the app to the front
user_sees: The tab comes back with a red dot and the number of new replies
must_not: The reply hidden because the switch is off

steps.action: Tap the tab, read the reply, close the sheet
user_sees: The tab goes away again (switch still off)
must_not: The tab stays after the reply was read

steps.action: Drag the tab to the left edge near the top, close and reopen the app
user_sees: The tab docks to the left edge, tucked behind it, at the same height after reopening
must_not: The tab left in mid-screen
A drag counted as a tap that opens the sheet
The tab back at the default spot

start: Member on an exercise page sends feedback

steps.action: Tap the tab, type a message, tap Send
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.'
must_not: The message going to the gym's owner or staff (it goes to MettleUp)
The screen name sent containing the exercise id (it must be 'exercise/:id')
More sent than the privacy notice lists: message, app version, phone model, screen, install number, coded IP
